notes: Framed photograph of a printed sheet: one thick black frame bar (~30 px) on all four sides, no thin inner rule and no corner arcs (rule 2 does not apply); paper shows outside the bar. Rule 1: the outline lies on paper 3-7 px inside the bar's inner edge. The edge was measured on every page line (first of 3 px in a row with lum > 0.8 inward of the bar, running median over +-60 px); points every 500 px, plus points wherever a straight segment would come within 3 px of the edge or of bar ink (lum < 0.6), or lie more than 7 px inside the edge. The bar is nearly straight (inner edge: left x 167, drifting to 158 below y ~5800; top y 162 at the left to 171 at the right; right x 4974-4969; bottom y 6386 at the left to 6381 at the right); its inner corners are slightly rounded and the corner points sit ~5-8 px inside both bars. No map ink comes near the frame, so nowhere does the outline touch ink: the nearest map ink is 121 px from the bottom side (x ~2850), 187 px from the top side, ~400 px from the left and right sides. Small bulges of bar ink on the top bar (x 3925-3945, y 170-176) and the right bar (y 2440-2450) are passed on paper with points round them; two single grey paper specks touch the right side (4967,458) and (4967,581). Inside: the '8 STORY HEIGHT LIMITATION NOT OVER 105 ft' box and the '40 ft HEIGHT LIMIT' lettering are zoning drawn on the map.
